name: services/tt/upcoming_share
description:
Get the webcal feed of the user's upcoming events.

Use this method to get the webcal URI needed to import user's upcoming events into external applications.
brief_description: Get the webcal feed of the user's upcoming events

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Preferred language of the calendar and its entries. This should be either pl or en.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of following fields and their values:

  • webcal_url - an URI with the webcal scheme.

result_fields.name: webcal_url
result_fields.description: an URI with the webcal scheme
